purpose: Replace type-only collision labels with behavior-based names for death response, action response, and scene transition paths.

promotions.name: ActorCollision_HandleDeathResponse

contract.dispatch: Receiving Type-0x04 actor-collision entry at ACTOR_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE + 0x18
contract.setup: Installs ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE04_COLLISION_RESPONSE as Type-0x84 state and clears the source actor
contract.phase: Decrements the receiver phase and selects ACTOR_ANIM_TYPE84_MOVING_CHILD_VARIANT_LOOP for phase values 0x07, 0x03, and 0x01
contract.terminal: Adds the receiver response weight, arms SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN=0x20, clears linked state, and initializes ACTOR_TEMPLATE_DEATH_84

evidence: Direct ACTOR_TEMPLATE_DEATH_84 load and SCENE_SCRIPT_COUNTDOWN=0x20 write

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_HandleActionResponse

contract.dispatch: Runtime Type-0x2D player-collision entry at PLAYER_COLLISION_HANDLER_TABLE + 0xB4; Type-0x2C shares the body
contract.ordinary: When PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD is clear, clears the source actor and routes through Player_ProcessInteractionState
contract.action: When the action-response gate is set, creates a Type-0x7F response with movement 0x001209BE and copies the source record
contract.allocation: Allocates the companion from ACTOR_TEMPLATE_TYPE_84 at 0x001B7E40 and optionally queues event 0x21

evidence: Direct PLAYER_ACTION_RESPONSE_FIELD gate and Type-0x7F writes

promotions.name: PlayerCollision_ProcessSceneTransition

contract.gates: Requires the player interaction-animation and terrain-push gates before evaluating actor/player X proximity
contract.modes: Uses INTERACTION_COUNTER_SECONDARY_DIGITS thresholds 05 and 10 to select scene-resource modes 0x11, 0x14, and 0x16
contract.completion: Decrements the secondary counter, increments GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER when permitted, advances ACTIVE_SCENE_ENTRY_GATE on the right-side path, and schedules resource presentation

evidence: Direct SCENE_RESOURCE_MODE, GAME_DIFFICULTY_COUNTER, ACTIVE_SCENE_ENTRY_GATE, and camera-threshold writes

conclusion: The promoted names distinguish actor death response, player action response, and player-driven scene transition behavior while retaining their dispatch-type aliases.
